_comment: Uses this widget's own token, then the variable token_env names, which defaults to $GITHUB_TOKEN. It does not read any other widget's section: a token here and a different one under `github` is an ordinary thing to want, and borrowing would run this widget on a credential its own settings screen never showed. Empty accounts discovers the viewer login and every org they belong to. Empty repos means recently-pushed repos that have workflow files, capped at max_repos per owner so one busy org cannot hide personal — never every repo the token can see. The screen names the cap.
_token_comment: This widget's GitHub token. Empty falls through to the variable token_env names, not to another widget's token.
_token_env_comment: Which environment variable holds the token, when `token` is empty. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN. This is a variable name, never a credential.
_accounts_comment: GitHub users or organizations to inspect; empty discovers the viewer and their organizations.
_repos_comment: Explicit owner/repository names; empty discovers recently pushed repositories with workflows.
_window_hours_comment: Hours of workflow runs included in summaries.
_max_repos_comment: Maximum discovered repositories inspected per account.
_pushed_days_comment: How recently a repository must have been pushed to qualify for discovery.
